+\"\"\"Minimal standard-library client for OpenAI's Responses API.\"\"\"
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+from typing import Any
+
+
+API_BASE_URL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"
+RESPONSES_ENDPOINT = f\"{API_BASE_URL}/responses\"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = \"gpt-4o-mini\"
+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60.0
+
+
+class OpenAIClientError(RuntimeError):
+    \"\"\"Raised when a Responses API request fails.\"\"\"
+
+
+def send_text_prompt(
+    prompt: str,
+    *,
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
+    api_key: str | None = None,
+    timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    **parameters: Any,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    \"\"\"Send a private text prompt and return the raw Responses API payload.\"\"\"
+
+    if not prompt:
+        raise ValueError(\"prompt must not be empty\")
+
+    request_api_key = api_key or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")
+    if not request_api_key:
+        raise OpenAIClientError(
+            \"OPENAI_API_KEY is not set; pass api_key or export OPENAI_API_KEY\"
+        )
+
+    payload: dict[str, Any] = {\"model\": model, \"input\": prompt}
+    payload.update(parameters)
+
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        RESPONSES_ENDPOINT,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(\"utf-8\"),
+        method=\"POST\",
+        headers={
+            \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {request_api_key}\",
+            \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
+        },
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
+            response_data = response.read()
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+        try:
+            details = error.read().decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")
+        except OSError:
+            details = \"\"
+        raise OpenAIClientError(f\"OpenAI HTTP {error.code}: {details}\") from error
+    except urllib.error.URLError as error:
+        raise OpenAIClientError(f\"Could not reach OpenAI: {error.reason}\") from error
+
+    try:
+        return json.loads(response_data)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
+        raise OpenAIClientError(\"OpenAI returned invalid JSON\") from error
+
+
+def response_text(response: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    \"\"\"Extract the assistant text from a Responses API payload.\"\"\"
+
+    output_text = response.get(\"output_text\")
+    if isinstance(output_text, str):
+        return output_text
+
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    for item in response.get(\"output\", []):
+        if item.get(\"type\") "'!= "message":
+            continue
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") == "output_text":
+                text = content.get("text", "")
+                if text:
+                    parts.append(text)
+
+    if parts:
+        return "'"\\n\".join(parts)
+
+    raise OpenAIClientError(\"Response contains no assistant text\")
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Send one text prompt to OpenAI.\")
+    parser.add_argument(\"prompt\")
+    parser.add_argument(\"--model\", default=DEFAULT_MODEL)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    try:
+        print(response_text(send_text_prompt(args.prompt, model=args.model)))
+    except (OpenAIClientError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise SystemExit(str(error)) from error
*** End Patch
PATCH
